d:
Neha Bora addressed the INDIA bloc's protest gathering at Ramlila Maidan in New Delhi, where Leader of the Opposition in the Lok Sabha Rahul Gandhi and other Opposition leaders raised concerns over alleged voter deletions and the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls.
Speaking at the gathering, Ms. Bora alleged irregularities in voter lists across several States, including Karnataka, Uttar Pradesh, West Bengal and Uttarakhand. She described the movement to protect voting rights and constitutional freedoms as a "Second Battle of Independence".
